sentences.en: He has disposed of what was left of his estate.
sentences.zh: 他处置了剩下的个人财产。

sentences.en: I agree with the opinion that real estate is overpriced.
sentences.zh: 我同意房地产价格被高估的观点。

sentences.en: He negotiated a lower price with the real estate agent.
sentences.zh: 他与房产中介协商降低了价格。

senses.zh: 财产，遗产，房地产,个人财产,不动产权,（较高的）社会地位adj.（汽车）连箱的（拥有较长的车身和后门，后座后面有较大的空间）
